exempt.PousCheck.SetupProtocolMain: the pous-setup executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of PousCheck.SetupProtocol.protocol, audited under PousCheck and CoreProtocol
exempt.PousCheck.SetupDifftestMain: the pous-setup-difftest server's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve of PousCheck.SetupDifftest.table, which tests/test_setup_difftest.py drives against the Python reference; audited under PousCheck
exempt.PousCheck.RunMain: the pous-run executable's entry point: with four files (the verifier's trusted keys, the setup, the table, the session) and the designated id, PousCheck.Run.run, the composed check of a recorded run, audited under PousCheck; with `serve`, Difftest.serve of PousCheck.Run.runFn, which tests/test_run.py drives against run.check_at, and of PousCheck.RunProtocol.certifyFn, which tests/test_run_protocol.py drives against period.certify and period.profile
exempt.PousCheck.DifftestMain: the difftest against the Python verifier, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of PousCheck.Difftest.main, audited under PousCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.PousCheck.VerdictDifftestMain: the pous-verdict-difftest server's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve of PousCheck.VerdictDifftest's gates and eval, which tests/test_verdict_difftest.py drives against the Definition verdict_circuit.PousVerdict, compiled; audited under PousCheck
exempt.PousCheck.RunProtocolMain: the pous-run-protocol executable's entry point, one line: Core.Protocol.main of PousCheck.RunProtocol.protocol (testProtocol under --test), audited under PousCheck and CoreProtocol; tests/test_run_protocol.py drives its serve against the Python reference

PousCheck.DifftestMain.why: generated instances on which PousCheck's definitions give what the Python verifier gives: the verification tree (reference.leaf, verifier.leaf_hash, root, path, wire.path_length, verify_path on honest and tampered paths), with the spec's section 7 pins of the audit vectors' file and frames

PousCheck.why: the program is code: Lean core, Flock's executable primitives, the core protocol interface, the core primitives (identity, randomness) and the memory challenger's verdict (PousCheck.Run composes it with the setup) only, no Mathlib and nothing of Security (Daniel's layout ruling, 5 Oct)
